tasks.build: bash scripts/job.sh build deno task build:inner
tasks.build:all: bash scripts/job.sh build deno task build:all:inner
tasks.build:all:inner: deno task web && cargo build --workspace --release --features gui
tasks.test: bash scripts/job.sh test bash scripts/isolated.sh cargo test --workspace && cd web && deno task check && deno task test
tasks.smoke: bash scripts/job.sh test bash scripts/isolated.sh bash scripts/smoke.sh
